        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The UHPIC unlocks ZPM Energy Hatches and Dynamos, as well as the Active Transformer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You may know the drill, but do you know the screwdriver?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Ultra High Power Integrated Circuit",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Dielectric PCB Coolant is used to maintain some highly advanced late and end-game machinery.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You only need a little bit in LuV, but you'll want to automate it when you get to ZPM.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Absolutely beneficial for the environment",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Dielectric PCB Coolant",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Active Transformer is a multiblock used to transform energy on a much larger scale. For example, you can convert HV to LV power directly by using the apropriate energy hatches.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "It also has a second function, detailed in the above quest.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: This is yet another feature from TecTech, which also required these cables to be painted. They do look fantastic if you paint them, but it's optional in CEu.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "More than a large transformer",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Active Transformer",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Data Bank is a multiblock capable of storing huge amounts of data. You can fill it with Data Access Hatches, and fill those with Data Storage Items.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "After that, you'll need power, and then a way to connect it to your Assembly Line! This is done through Optical Fiber Cables, which can be used to link Optical Data Hatches together.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "An Optical Transmission Hatch is used to send data (like an output), and an Optical Reception Hatch to recieve the data (like an input).",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Optical cables have some restrictions however. They can only connect one input to one output. The Data Bank is your answer to this, since you can place many hatches on them to route your data anywhere.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You can use this behavior to chain Data Banks as well. Connecting one Data Bank to another, and then one of them to an Assembly Line will provide the data of both banks!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: This multiblock will be required later on in progression, but is very useful to set up early.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: This multiblock also originates from TecTech, but part of its mechanics required optical cables to be painted as well. You don't have to do that here, but it looks really nice if you do!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Time for a server room",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Mass Data Storage",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Active Transformer has a second use - Laser Power. Lasers are like superconductors, but behave slightly differently. They share the energy input across all connected active transformers, allowing widespread power distribution. You can use Active Transformers to convert regular EU to and from Lasers.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Like optical cables, they can only be connected to one input and output. But, these ones also only can move in straight lines. To turn them, an Active Transformer with a Laser Source Hatch (output) and Target Hatch (input) is needed.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "text": "Doping Silicon with Naquadah will give a better Silicon Boule.",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Use it for higher yield on Wafers.",

          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/luv__ludicrous_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This will also unlock the best recipe for HV Circuits in the LuV Circuit Assembler. You're probably going to want to mass produce these for the many Lapotronic Energy Orbs that'll be required moving forwards.",

          "label": "luv__ludicrous_voltage",

        {

        {

          "text": "Naquadah is a late-game material with a variety of uses. It is required when building a Fusion Reactor and progressing to ZPM, to name a few.",

        {

          "text": "For some reason, its fluid is a brilliant green - don't ask us why.",

        {

          "text": "Firmalife adds some berry bushes. For information on wild grape bushes, see winemaking.",

          "label": "Berry Bushes",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,

        },
        {

          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmalife/berry_bushes",
          "source": "jar:Firmalife-1.20.1-2.1.27.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmalife/berry_bushes.json",
          "text": "First is nightshade. Nightshade is a poisonous berry. When put into soup, it makes poisonous Stinky Soup. It is found between 200-400mm of rain and 7-24 C temperature in forests.",

          "label": "Berry Bushes",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmalife/berry_bushes",
          "source": "jar:Firmalife-1.20.1-2.1.27.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmalife/berry_bushes.json",
          "text": "Pineapple bushes are found 250-500mm of rainfall and 20-32 C temperature in forests. Pineapples are like any other fruit, except that they can be made into Pineapple Leather.",

          "label": "Berry Bushes",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmalife/berry_bushes",
          "source": "jar:Firmalife-1.20.1-2.1.27.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmalife/berry_bushes.json",
          "text": "Pineapples that have been Dried can be crafted into pineapple fiber.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Berry Bushes",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 6
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/firmalife/berry_bushes",
          "source": "jar:Firmalife-1.20.1-2.1.27.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/firmalife/berry_bushes.json",
          "text": "Pineapple yarn is made by crafting a Spindle with the fiber.",

          "label": "Berry Bushes",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 6
        },

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "Thirst is represented by the blue bar above your hunger. You can and will die of dehydration if you dont keep your thirst meter filled! The easiest way to have a drink is by drinking from natural ponds in the wild, by right-clicking on them with an empty hand.",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsstoneage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "To complete this quest, you need to drink a Potable source of water, can be regular or river water. You may need to drink multiple times so the quest completes properly",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsstoneage.snbt",
          "text": "You don't have to worry about purifying water here, though Salt Water will just make you more thirsty.",

          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This Superconductor will be required for progression during LuV.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "IV Superconductors",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "If you already made and centrifuged Rare Earth, that's great! If you haven't, you can obtain it as a Byproduct from various ores, or from centrifuging Monazite.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "To extract the Rare Earths, you should use a Centrifuge as high a tier as possible, due to the increased chance of bonus outputs.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The elements you can obtain are:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Lanthanum is used in Fusion - you will eventually want a lot of it!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Yttrium is used in Yttrium-Barium-Cuprate-Oxide (YBCO), a wire material for UV.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Cerium is not particularly useful.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Samarium is used for IV Superconductors and Magnetic Rods for LuV+ Motors.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Neodymium normally makes the strongest magnets, but gameplay balance... y'know.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Cadmium is not particularly useful.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: Rare Earth Elements (REE) contain a lot more metals than these, but we're struggling as is to give them use.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Rare Earth",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HSS-G Coils bring up the Heat Capacity to 5,400K.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The ever-tempting Coil bonuses should be high incentive to make those early, as they become mandatory only during LuV.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "At this point, you may go back to using only one Electric Blast Furnace for your entire base, powering with the highest available Voltage you have.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Hot Metals will start taking longer to cool down, as the Vacuum Freezer doesn't get perfect overclocks. For that, you probably want a dual (or quad) Vacuum Freezer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Approaching solar temperatures",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HSS-G Coils",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "High-Speed Steels (HSS) are more resistant Steel Alloys typically used in Rails.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "If you previously made Ultimet for whatever reason, you've already acquired Molybdenum. Otherwise, it can be found in a Nether vein.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "We hope you have a lot of Tungstensteel, because you're still gonna need more! It's used for the creation of HSS alloys - in this case, HSS-G.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HSS-G",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Technically, HSS-E doesn't contain Manganese, but some other HSS alloys do have Manganese, so... close enough?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HSS-E has some niche uses in progression.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This alloy has great durability and damage property for tools. It has the best Power multiplier (until Neutronium!) as a Rotor for Large Turbines, though it's slightly less efficient than HSS-S.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HSS-E",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "When running the Extreme Combustion Engine, you're gonna want to boost it! Why bother otherwise?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Get yourself a 4A IV Dynamo Hatch as the output, and one Vacuum Freezer for Liquid Oxygen.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You should now be wielding the equivalent of 1 LuV Amp, all whilst burning fuel at 200% efficiency!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Don't forget to keep it supplied with a small amount of Lubricant.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The ECE is also void-free, unlike Large Turbines. Any energy that cannot be output will momentarily pause the multiblock.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: The ECE comes from GT:NH. However... its implementation wasn't so rosy at first. The stats on the tooltip looked similar to this one - so far, so good.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The bad part came when crunching the numbers. Players ended up realizing they needed to run around 16 whole HV Vacuum Freezers to keep up with the Liquid Oxygen demand...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The one and only fuel it would accept is High Octane Gasoline, which was stated to be burned at 300% efficiency when boosted, but the UI was lying. The efficiency remained at 100%.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The GT:NH team eventually decided to rework the ECE among other power options... phew!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The ultimate Combustion generator!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Extreme Combustion Engine",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You should have all the tools available to produce Polybenzimidazole on your own!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "PBI only becomes mandatory to progress from LuV to ZPM, but tackling it earlier will unlock the Advanced SMDs.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "GTCEu's toughest polymer!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Better SMDs to make far more complex Circuits at a much cheaper price.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "These'll require Alloys that you have not made yet, most of which will be common in LuV and onwards.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Advanced SMDs are required for the Crystal Circuit line.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Advanced SMDs",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Tungstensteel under your belt? Nanoprocessor Mainframes on demand? Let's make some machinery.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The IV Assembler is required to unlock IV Energy and Dynamo Hatches, as well as HSS-G Coils.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Upgrading this to its GCYM variant isn't a bad idea.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/iv__insane_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: Did you know that GTCE's content stopped at EV, and all content up to UV was provided by Shadows of Greg, a third party mod?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "iv__insane_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Candidate player storage section inferred from pack evidence; accept only if it is a useful way to group items."
    },

      "semantic_evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "runtime_item",
          "id": "gtceu:titanium_bolt",
          "source": "runtime-items",
          "text": "Ti",
          "key": "runtime-tooltip",
          "label": "Titanium Bolt",
          "item_ref_count": 1
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "hv__high_voltage",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Energium Crystals store a significant amount of EU. They're also arguably cheaper.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Science-fiction batteries!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Super Batteries",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The HV Autoclave - despite being optional - is a machine you'll definitively want to grab.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This unlocks unique Batteries that are far superior to their standard counterparts.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Home-grown batteries",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HV Autoclave",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The HV Chemical Bath is used to dye Lenses using Chemical Dye. This will let you engrave more types of Wafers, and cool other kinds of Hot Ingots.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Please don't bathe with your toaster...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "High Voltage Bathing",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You now have access to two new Maintenance Hatches.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Automatic Maintenance Hatch is pretty simple - it eliminates the need for Maintenance, forever.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Configurable Maintenance Hatch is more interesting. You can configure it to cut off 10%% duration on recipes, at the cost of making Maintenance happen three times as fast. That is 16 real hours of activity. Additionally, you can use it on Multiblock Generators to increase the duration of the recipe, which indirectly increases their fuel efficiency by 10%%!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Reminder: You can put Tape in the maintenance Hatch to automatically fix problems.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: The Automatic Maintenance Hatch texture and mechanic comes from TecTech, an addon mod originally made for GregTech: New Horizons.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You'll see more from TecTech if you stick with us with the late game.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "I have become maintenance, eater of tape",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Advanced Maintenance",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Just like MV, you'll need to make higher-tier components.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The painful Flawless Gems have been replaced with slightly-more-painful Vitrified Ender Pearls. Also notice that the Motors require 2x Silver Cables.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Hulls and Machines use Gold Cables.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Finally, a use for that stockpile of Gold!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Tips to make life less painful:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Use Electrotine decomposition and Ore Processing for Electrum.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Use the Chemical Bath with Mercury for Gold and Silver from a wide variety of ores.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "We call this \"fun\"",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "High Voltage Components",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The HV Assembler is the next step in progression, but also unlocks a handful of useful utilities - check around this quest for more.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You will need this HV Assembler to make your Rocket.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HV Assembler",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You'll want to grab these two lenses. The Simple System on Chip will be used for the best ULV Circuit recipe, while the LPIC Wafer is required for your next Energy Hatch.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "I see the world in colour",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "ULV Circuits are used in some AE2 recipes and Create recipes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Best ULV circuits!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Low Power Integrated Circuit requires an HV Cutter inside your Cleanroom.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "HV Energy Hatches will be nice additions so you can run your Multiblocks (mainly your Electric Blast Furnace and Large Chemical Reactor) directly off a HV line.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Noticing a pattern here?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Upgrade your EBF II",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The HV Chemical Reactor unlocks a ton of new recipes. Ah, who doesn't love the ever-growing demand on more advanced Chemistry?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: We've actually unlocked a ton of new content by reaching HV. However, not every processing line or item is crucial right now. It'd make the HV chapter far too dense if we included everything!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You could still check out the EV Chapter if you want to push yourself.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "High Voltage Chemistry",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Titanium requires a slightly more involved process than the previous materials to process. To get started, you'll need Rutile, which can be obtained by processing Ilmenite that you can get from Bauxite, Aluminium, Armalcolite and Desh, which can be found in massive quantities on The Moon.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Once you've gotten enough Rutile, your journey to Titanium continues in the next quest. There's no need to rush things.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Tip: Ore processing for Bauxite is ridiculously good! It can easily triples your Rutile yield.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "...means it WASN'T Titanium!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Almost Titanium",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "To get your grubby hands on some Titanium, Rutile must first be reduced to Titanium Tetrachloride in an HV Chemical Reactor, then reduced again in an EBF with Magnesium to finally arrive at Titanium.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Carbon, Chlorine, Oxygen, and Magnesium used in the process can be perfectly recovered from the byproduct Carbon Monoxide and Magnesium Chloride with no loss. If you set up a system to recover them, the only material that you'll need to provide for Titanium is Rutile!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Titanium Tetrachloride also acts as a catalyst in the production of plastics. A touch of TiCl₄ in the polymerisation process can increase the polymer yield to 133%%. Naturally, this is completely optional.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/hv__high_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "key": "quest-snbt",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "This... is a Bucket.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The final task in the Metallurgy Age is creating a Bucket. Unlike the wooden bucket and other fluid containers you've been using until now, the Bucket can be used to carry Lava and move around source blocks of other fluids.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",

          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "With the Black Steel Anvil you'll now be able to work Black Steel Ingots into different items.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "You've also now opened up a massive new section in the Early Automation chapter related to high pressure Steam Power!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "From here, you can either dive straight into industrialization or finish up the last tier of anvils if you'd like. You can't avoid colored steel forever, though!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Steam power is within your grasp",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "T5 Anvil: Black Steel",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "With the Steel Anvil, you'll be able to work Steel Ingots into different forms.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Steel tools and equipment have a significant boost over their bronze and wrought iron counterparts, so they're worth making if your existing ones are about to break. You'll be needing to create a lot of alloys soon, so some new mining equipment would be a wise investment.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:mechanics/steel",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "A huge leap from wrought iron",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "T4 Anvil: Steel",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "With the Wrought Iron Anvil you'll be able to work Wrought Iron Ingots into different items such as Sheets, Tool heads, etc.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Wrought Iron tools and armor isn't much of an improvement over Bronze, but it has far more durability.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Creating the next anvil is going to be a significant step up in difficulty, so this is a good point to settle down and explore some of the other things this modpack has to offer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:tfg_tips/anvil_working_guide",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Waterwheels, Windmills and more Greate",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "T3 Anvil: Wrought Iron",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "To work metal into more than just double ingots, you'll need to use an anvil of the same tier or better. Working on an anvil can be a little bit complicated, but there's an entry in the TFG Tips section of the field guide that goes into more detail.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Bronze also marks the start of automation, where you'll begin to harness mechanical power!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Basic mechanical power starts here",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "ftbfiltersystem:item_tag(tfc:bronze_anvils)",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "{quests.tasktype.item.any} #tfc:bronze_anvils",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "T2 Anvil: Bronze",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Obtain at least 14 Ingots of any Bronze type, then weld them together in the Copper Anvil.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Tier 2 Anvil can be made from Bismuth Bronze, Bronze or Black Bronze, but not a mixture of the three.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "I told you to get used to it",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:bronze_double_ingot)item(gtceu:black_bronze_double_ingot)item(gtceu:bismuth_bronze_double_ingot))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "{quests.tasktype.item.any} #forge:double_ingots/bronze",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Welding Bronze",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Bloomery is a Multiblock from TerraFirmaCraft that allows you to create Wrought Iron. Melting iron in a forge will produce Cast Iron, which is brittle and nowhere near as strong or durable as Wrought Iron.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Bloomery is expensive, so it will be worth investing some time into setting up automatic plate production and ore processing.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Field Guide contains a detailed entry on how the Bloomery works and the correct ratios of iron and fuel that it needs.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:mechanics/bloomery",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Required if you seek the Iron Age.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Blast Furnace is a multiblock structure that allows you to create Pig Iron. Placing a combination of Iron, Flux and fuel (see the adjacent quest) inside the Blast Furnace produces Pig Iron, which can be worked into Steel.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "In order for the Blast Furnace to reach its required high temperatures, it will need its own Bellows, used to force air through a Tuyere which you place inside the blast furnace.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Field Guide contains an entry on how the Blast Furnace works and how to build one.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

        },
        {

        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Bellows is a device that can force extra air into a fire or forge in front of it, allowing the heat produced by the fuel inside to reach higher temperatures than usual, at the cost of fuel duration.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "These higher temperatures are required to fire pottery with charcoal or melt certain metals.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },

          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

        {
