          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Once you find Kaolin Clay, you should bring as much back as you can possibly carry! Unfortunately, only 20 percent of it will successfully cook into Kaolinite Powder, so it's recommended to bake it in situ with pit kilns, to save inventory space.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "After you craft the Crucible and the Blast Furnace, you won't need much more of it, but it's still a good idea to bring home more than you think you'll need, to avoid a repeat journey.",

          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

          "text": "P.S.: If you've found blood lilies but no clay, try digging down a little further! Sometimes it spawns a little underground.",

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "text": "Animal Husbandry",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Animal Husbandry",
          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 40
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry.json",
          "text": "Livestock are animals that can be tamed and bred by the player. Livestock can be either male or female. For some animals, it is possible to tell their sex visually. For example, male pigs have tusks.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Animal Husbandry",
          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 40
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry.json",
          "text": "Livestock experience aging. They are born as babies, which are smaller and cannot provide things for the player. After a certain number of days, they grow into adult animals, which are able to do things like breed or produce milk. After they breed or are used enough times, animals become old, and are only useful for their meat.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Animal Husbandry",
          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 40
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry.json",
          "text": "This bull is old and cannot breed, so it has a faded coat and grey, unseeing eyes.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Animal Husbandry",
          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 40
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry.json",
          "text": "Livestock can be fed to raise familiarity. Each animal has foods that it prefers to eat. To feed an animal, and with food in your hand.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Animal Husbandry",
          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 40
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry.json",
          "text": "Livestock have a Familiarity Indicator that shows how familiar they are with you. Hold and look at the animal to reveal it.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Animal Husbandry",
          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 40
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry.json",
          "text": "Familiarity decays a little each day if not fed. Raising the familiarity enough prevents decay, indicated by the white outlined heart.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Animal Husbandry",
          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 40
        },
        {

          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry",
          "source": "jar:TerraFirmaCraft-Forge-1.20.1-3.2.21.jar!assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry.json",
          "text": "Adult livestock cannot be fully familiarized, indicated by the red outlined heart. Babies can reach 100% familiarity.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Animal Husbandry",
          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 40
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/animal_husbandry",

          "text": "Mammals are livestock that experience Pregnancy. Adult mammals that are above 30% familiarity and have been fed that day will mate, given that they are of opposite genders and near each other. The female animal will become pregnant, which causes it to have children a set number of days after fertilization. An example is Pigs.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Animal Husbandry",
          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 40
        },
        {

          "text": "Wooly Animals are Mammals that can be Sheared if they are adults and familiar enough to you. Some examples are Sheep, Alpacas, and Musk Oxen.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Animal Husbandry",
          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 40

          "text": "Dairy Animals are mammals that make Milk. Female dairy animals can be clicked with a bucket to obtain milk. Some examples are Goats, Cows, and Yaks.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Animal Husbandry",
          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,

          "text": "Oviparous Animals are not Mammals, and instead produce children by laying Eggs. They need a Nest Box to lay eggs, which they are capable of locating on their own. Some examples are Ducks, Quails, and Chickens.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",

          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,

          "text": "Eggs can be cooked or boiled for food. Male oviparous animals can fertilize females, which causes the next egg laid in the nest box to be fertilized. Fertilized eggs will have a tooltip with how long until they are ready to hatch.",

          "label": "Animal Husbandry",
          "item_ref_count": 12,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 40

          "text": "Equines are Mammals that can be ridden when tamed. They become rideable after reaching 15% familiarity.",

          "text": "They need a Saddle to ride, which can be Knapped. This includes Mules, Donkeys, and Horses. Mules and Donkeys can hold any chest or barrel.           "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Enriched Naquadah is an isotope of Naquadah, Nq-528. It is radioactive and will be used in (as of yet) unimplemented nuclear reactors.",

        {

        {

        {

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The Research Station is the upgrade to the Scanner. It's used for more advanced forms of research, and will finally allow you to perform research which requires Data Orbs and Modules.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "When running the Research Station, energy and Computation is needed. The latter is provided through an HPCA, which is explained in the next quest. It is recieved with a Computation Data Reception Hatch. Note that only one Reception Hatch is allowed in a Research Station.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "This multiblock needs computation sporadically, which means the recipe will not reverse progress if you don't supply enough - it will simply halt in-place. However, the machine will still draw energy constantly, even when recieving no computation.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "To scan items, the process is relatively similar. In the Object Holder, place the target item in the center slot, and the data storage item in the other slot. Then provide computation, and the data storage item will be updated upon completion. When running, the target item will be Locked and cannot be removed.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Note: To form this multiblock, the Object Holder must face the controller.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Your research adventures continue!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Research Station",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The UV Mainframe is required to move into Fusion Mk2.",

          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "It's also made in the Assembly Line.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Passing over the ingredients we've already seen before, watch out for the HSS-E Frames.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "...ah, here we go!",

          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "First UV Circuits!",

        },
        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The Crystal SoC is used to make cheaper Crystal Circuits. Enjoy the discount!",

        {

        },
        {

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Space is home to many other kinds of animals than those you'd find on Earth. A few animals are hostile and will attack the player, but most are passive. Only a few of them are domesticatable. Animals you find on other worlds can be divided into two categories: hot and cold. Animals can only survive on planets that either have a similar climate to where they came from, or on temperate planets like Earth.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Space animals do not require an oxygenated environment, but it will make the area count as \"temperate\" for their survival. For example, if you bring a cold-dwelling animal (like a Sniffer) to a hot planet (like Venus), it will catch on fire, unless it's inside an oxygenated environment. This makes Earth the ideal place to build a zoo, if you'd like. You can transport animals between planets using AE2's Spatial Storage system.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Moon Animals",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",

          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "The Moon may be pretty barren, but it still has a few animals that call it home. It's considered a Cold world despite the pretty extreme temperature swings.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {

          "count": 32

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Besides their coloring, Moon Rabbits have identical stats to Earth rabbits. They also eat Chorus Fruit.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Limpets are a type of snail with ore on their shell. You can obtain the ore with any mining tool. They are passive and can be eaten.",

          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",

          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Birts are a type of bird? They lay eggs in their nests, are passive unless attacked, and can be eaten. Their eggs can be thrown to stun targets.",

          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",

        {

          "text": "Mars is the planet with an environment closest to Earth's, featuring a wide variety of animals to interact with and crops to feed them (and yourself) with... outside of the huge desert, where almost nothing lives. Mars is a Cold planet.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },

          "text": "Sniffers are domesticatable animals found between -30 and -102°C. They require a Large Nest to lay their eggs and can be shorn for Sniffer Tufts. Their eggs can be cooked or extracted for Cream. They eat any Mars crop.",

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Preferring extremely cold environments below -108°C, Glacian Sheep are domesticatable animals. They can be shorn for Glacian Wool, an amazing insulator. They eat any Mars crop.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "A glacian ram/ewe.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.15.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Snatchers are passive animals that like to steal your stuff! Attack them to retrieve your items, or feed them Raw Fish to tame them. Once tamed, you can carry them on your back and equip them with a wooden chest. Press to throw them, and they will steal the contents of a nearby chest and bring it to you.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "A snatcher.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.17.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Chargers are semipassive animals. You can tame them with any Mars crop to use them as a combat land mount. Press for a headbutt attack, or press and hold Spacebar for a charge attack. They can also be equipped with dyeable armor.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Chargers have a natural rivalry with Raiders. They will attack each other on sight.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.19.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Surfers are semiaquatic passive animals. You can tame them with Raw Fish to ride them underwater. They can also be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Soarers are passive animals found above -106°C. You can tame them with Raw Fish to use them as a flying mount. They can also be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "A top predator, Eaters are hostile animals found above -109°C. If you can manage to take one down, they can be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Crunchers are territorial miniboss predators. Feed them meat to stop their regeneration. They can also be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Despite their name, Gliders cannot be tamed or ridden. They are passive and live in areas above -105°C. They enjoy music and can be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Crushers are semihostile animals found in herds in areas above -100°C. They can be killed for their meat and hard spikes.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Springlings are wild animals found above -108°C. Feeding them Saplings will let you ride them and extend their extremely long necks. They can also be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Goobers are lazy wild animals found above -109°C. They are passive and can be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.27.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "The gigantic Walkers inhabit areas above -97°C. They are passive and can be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.28.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Raiders are hostile animals found above -109°C. They have a natural rivalry with Chargers. You can make them neutral by feeding them Raw Meat.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.29.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "Toxlacanths are aquatic prey animals. It is recommended to kill them from a distance and cook their meat before eating.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.30.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_tips/space_fauna.json",
          "text": "One of the few animals that can survive the Martian desert, Stackaticks are passive prey animals. They can also be eaten.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.31.text",
          "label": "Extraterrestrial Fauna",
          "item_ref_count": 27,
          "count": 32
        },

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "First, like the Moon, Mars will have some hostile surface mobs as well. If you haven't already figured out how to make your Space Suit stay with you after dying or invested in new EV-tier weaponry, you'll have a rough time.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The planet is mostly a desert world, dotted with \"islands\" where you’ll find water, lush fauna, and much safer places to build your first base. Meanwhile, the open desert is extremely dangerous if you don't watch your step, but contains some other crucial resources!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "All fluid veins are spread across Mars, except for Heavy Ammoniacial Water which can only be found outside of the desert. That’s another good reason to set up your base there.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Energy-wise, Mars will not be kind to you at first.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Nearly every common energy generation method is disabled or worthless on the planet, which means you’ll have to rely almost entirely on Fission to power your base.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "At the very beginning, we recommend bringing along some filled batteries such as Lapotron Crystals to get started, and then look towards setting up Thorium Fuel Rods.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Achieving energy stability on Mars will take time and effort, but once your systems are running smoothly, you’ll feel like unlimited power is right in the palm of your hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "And one last tip: don’t kill everything you see. Some animals can be ranched, and you’ll definitely need them later in your progression.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Be sure to check out the Space Survival chapter for more Mars-related tips too!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Stay alert, plan ahead, and Mars will reward your courage.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The Red Planet",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Land on Mars",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "I'm on Mars!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The water on Mars is Semiheavy which means it contains one Deuterium atom, and is also full of Ammonia, a great antifreeze, which is how it can stay liquid despite the very low temperatures.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "It's technically drinkable, but you'll likely want to distill it into normal Water first. You can also move source blocks of Semiheavy Ammoniacal Water around and get more of it via an Aqueous Accumulator, just like regular Water.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "You can also centrifuge the Ammonium Chloride out from it and electrolyze it as a source of Nitrogen. Easy Nitrox from just one source!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Fancy a drink?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Semiheavy Ammoniacal Water",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Dotted around the vast Martian deserts are small \"islands\" of life and vegetation, which are probably where you'll want to set up your base. Surviving here will be much easier than in the desert!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Is that a dinosaur?!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/glassworking_applications.json",
          "text": "The most simple glass products are Glass Panes and Glass Blocks. In order to craft them, you must start with a Blowpipe with a Glass Batch, and then perform a Pour. - Table Pours are used to create Glass Panes - Basin Pours are used to create Glass Blocks",

          "label": "Glass Products",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 16
        },

          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/glassworking_applications",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/mechanics/glassworking_applications.json",
          "text": "Glass can also be dyed before it is poured to create colored glass. The color is dependent on the type of glass batch, and any powders that have been added. Each type of Glass Batch has a different natural color of glass that they will create. Silica glass batches can be made into many colors, Olivine, and Volcanic glass can be made into relatively few colors.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Glass Products",
          "item_ref_count": 8,
          "recipe_ref_count": 5,
          "count": 16
        },

          "text": "Glass Panes are made with a Table Pour. A pouring table is made by placing up to sixteen Kaolin Clay Blocks or Brass Plated Blocks in a continuous area. 1. Add a Glass Batch to a Blowpipe. 2. Heat the blowpipe to Faint Red. 3. the Blowpipe on the top of the table. 4. Finally with a Paddle to flatten the glass.",

          "text": "The most simple glass products are Glass Panes and Glass Blocks. In order to craft them, you must start with a Blowpipe with a Glass Batch, and then perform a Pour. - Table Pours are used to create Glass Panes - Basin Pours are used to create Glass Blocks",

          "text": "Glass can also be dyed before it is poured to create colored glass. The color is dependent on the type of glass batch, and any powders that have been added. Each type of Glass Batch has a different natural color of glass that they will create. Silica glass batches can be made into many colors, Olivine, and Volcanic glass can be made into relatively few colors.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",

          "count": 16

          "text": "Glass Panes are made with a Table Pour. A pouring table is made by placing up to sixteen Brass Plated Blocks in a continuous area. 1. Add a Glass Batch to a Blowpipe. 2. Heat the blowpipe to Faint Red. 3. the Blowpipe on the top of the table. 4. Finally with a Paddle to flatten the glass.",

          "text": "Fuel is hard to get; it requires venturing out to the ocean, looking for oil spouts. The Cryo Freezer introduces a new way to obtain a better fuel - Cryo Fuel. Cryo Fuel is much more efficient than refined fuel, allowing you to launch a rocket with just one bucket.",

        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",

          "item_ref_count": 32

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",

        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",

          "text": "The Sifter is used for ore processing to increase your yield of Certus Quartz, Quartzite, Nether Quartz, Ruby, and Armalcolite—all of which are essential for AE2.           "item_ref_count": 32

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The second machine, the Mixer, is your only method to create Fluix Crystals (more about that in the next quest). Don’t forget that you can also use the Greate Mixer as a HS-tier machine.",

          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Thirdly, a Laser Engraver can combine lesser quality gems together into Exquisite, which will give you better Fluix yields.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "You’ll need a massive amount of Fluix Crystals, especially since the liquid version is used in most Applied Energistics 2 recipes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "So prepare yourself—you’re going to need a lot!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Energetic Crystal",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Most of your Fluix Crystals will be converted into Liquid Fluix.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "However, make sure to keep a few in their crystal form for the occasional recipe that specifically requires it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Any Extractor will do the job here — no need for anything fancy.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The precious fluix",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:lv_extractor)item(gtceu:mv_extractor)item(gtceu:hv_extractor)item(gtceu:ev_extractor))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Any Extractor",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Fluid Extractor",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "We told you you'd need a vast quantity of Liquid Fluix… but we didn’t mention there’s a way to drastically increase your yield per Fluix Crystal.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Introducing: Cryogenized Fluix, an ultra-cold fluid only craftable on the Moon using a Vacuum Freezer. Simply combine Liquid Fluix with Helium-3!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "This special fluid can be used as a substitute in nearly all recipes that require Liquid Fluix—but only when you're crafting on the Moon.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Moon-based AE2 recipes come with huge benefits: reduced energy costs, less components needed, or sometimes both! Investing in a proper Moon base for AE2 production will pay off massively, especially in early game.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "It’s not strictly mandatory — yet. But setting up a second base now will ease your future progression, as planet-based infrastructure becomes essential later on. So… why not get ahead of the curve?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The Moon is so cheap",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Liquid Fluix",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Here you are, ready to begin your AE2 infrastructure!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "This chapter will mainly guide you through what you can and cannot craft yet.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "We’ll also highlight the most important items you should focus on.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "However, to fully understand Applied Energistics 2, we strongly recommend using the G keybind (similar to Create's Ponder system) or open the ME Guide we provide as a reward from this quest. It’s the best in-game tutorial for AE2.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Alternatively, watch some online videos about AE2 on 1.20.1 for more detailed explanations — AE2 is a very popular mod, so there's a ton of tutorials out there!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Pro tip: Many AE2 recipes have alternative Moon recipes that are much cheaper. Once again, investing in your Moon base will greatly reward you throughout the entire game.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Another free book for your collection!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Welcome to AE2",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "To get started, you’ll need to power your ME Network. These are the two AE2 blocks that can directly accept EU energy.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "We strongly recommend crafting a ME Controller, as channels are enabled in TerraFirmaGreg, and the ME Controller is the best way to manage multiple channels efficiently.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "This is also a great time to use the in-game guide (press U on a ME Controller) or watch some videos about AE2 on version 1.20.1 to learn more!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The beating heart of your ME network",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "To get the printed circuits, you'll need to craft the HV Forming Press.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "The good news? It has multiple input slots, meaning you can insert all your circuit presses at once, so a single Forming Press is enough to handle every printed circuit type.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Small is good too",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Forming Press",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "One of the last things you’ll need before diving fully into Applied Energistics 2 is collecting the 4 Presses.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "To obtain them, you must locate an AE2 Meteorite on the Moon — they will look like dark spheres at the bottom of large craters. Luckily, they aren't particularly rare, and a single meteorite will contain all four Presses.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Be careful though — these meteorites are often guarded, so gear up, bring an ore prospector if you have one, and happy hunting!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/applied_energistics_2",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/applied_energistics_2.snbt",
          "text": "Treasure hunt",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "applied_energistics_2",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Candidate player storage section inferred from pack evidence; accept only if it is a useful way to group items."
    },
    {
      "id": "pack:tfg/before_landing_on_mars_there_are_a_few_important_things_to_keep_in_mind",
      "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
      "origin": "pack_generated",
      "confidence": 0.65,
      "support": 32,
      "evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "confidence": 0.65
        }
      ],
      "semantic_evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "First, like the Moon, Mars will have some hostile surface mobs as well. If you haven't already figured out how to make your Space Suit stay with you after dying or invested in new EV-tier weaponry, you'll have a rough time.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The planet is mostly a desert world, dotted with \"islands\" where you’ll find water, lush fauna, and much safer places to build your first base. Meanwhile, the open desert is extremely dangerous if you don't watch your step, but contains some other crucial resources!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "All fluid veins are spread across Mars, except for Heavy Ammoniacial Water which can only be found outside of the desert. That’s another good reason to set up your base there.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Energy-wise, Mars will not be kind to you at first.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Nearly every common energy generation method is disabled or worthless on the planet, which means you’ll have to rely almost entirely on Fission to power your base.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "At the very beginning, we recommend bringing along some filled batteries such as Lapotron Crystals to get started, and then look towards setting up Thorium Fuel Rods.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Achieving energy stability on Mars will take time and effort, but once your systems are running smoothly, you’ll feel like unlimited power is right in the palm of your hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "And one last tip: don’t kill everything you see. Some animals can be ranched, and you’ll definitely need them later in your progression.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Be sure to check out the Space Survival chapter for more Mars-related tips too!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Stay alert, plan ahead, and Mars will reward your courage.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The Red Planet",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Land on Mars",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "I'm on Mars!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The water on Mars is Semiheavy which means it contains one Deuterium atom, and is also full of Ammonia, a great antifreeze, which is how it can stay liquid despite the very low temperatures.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "It's technically drinkable, but you'll likely want to distill it into normal Water first. You can also move source blocks of Semiheavy Ammoniacal Water around and get more of it via an Aqueous Accumulator, just like regular Water.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "You can also centrifuge the Ammonium Chloride out from it and electrolyze it as a source of Nitrogen. Easy Nitrox from just one source!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Fancy a drink?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Semiheavy Ammoniacal Water",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Dotted around the vast Martian deserts are small \"islands\" of life and vegetation, which are probably where you'll want to set up your base. Surviving here will be much easier than in the desert!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Is that a dinosaur?!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The Martian Jungles",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The majority of Mars is covered in a vast desert. Not much lives here except the occasional Stackatick, and of course the giant Sandworms. If this is your first time here, you'll want to find somewhere more hospitable! Otherwise, you'll want to keep searching...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Sand, sand everywhere",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Visit the Martian Deep Desert biome",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The Martian Desert",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "If you make too much noise in the desert, you might attract the attention of the mighty Sandworm! It's more of an environmental hazard than a boss to kill, so your best way of surviving it is to run away!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "If you manage to hit its head enough times with explosion damage, it will leave you alone... for a while.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Thankfully, the Sandworm can only damage entities, not buildings, and is only attracted to the footsteps of players, so any way to keep your own feet off the ground won't anger it. The atmosphere is too thin for airplanes and hang gliders, but there are other tools...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "SHAI-HULUD",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The Sandworm",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Ostrum Deposits are immovable blocks that you can only find in the Martian Deep Desert, far away from any of the more lush areas. They spawn in small blobs, and can be broken to make space for your Ostrum Harvester if they're on a slope. Try using a Spyglass to find them from a distance!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "You'll have to figure out some long-distance logistics to ship your Ostrum back to your base. (Try a train!)",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Ostrum is a crucial resource for both EV progression and making infinite ores from Mars.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
