          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The spice must flow",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Ostrum Deposits",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Is Mars not cold enough for you?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Head up (or down) towards one of its poles at Z=+15000/-5000. If anything's able to live there, surely it must have amazing insulative properties...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Cold enough for CO₂ to freeze!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The Martian Poles",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Heavy Ammoniacal Water is another kind of fluid that can only be found deep underground via a Fluid Drilling Rig. You can only find it in these lush areas of Mars, not the desert!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "You can separate it into Heavy Water, which is important for Fission power.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "The Cooler Ammoniacal Water",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Heavy Ammoniacal Water",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Unlike regular Sheep on Earth, killing a Glacian one will only give you normal Wool. You'll need to build up their familiarity and shear them if you want the special Glacian Wool.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "You'll need 7 of it for a full Tungstensteel Space Suit, but you can also use it as a great component for your Fission Reactor to increase its maximum heat.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "You can also turn it into regular Wool Yarn and Cloth if you want more of that for some reason.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "What an incredible insulator!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Glacian Wool",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Airplanes don't work on Mars, and your space suit doesn't have a jetpack, so there's no other way to fly, right?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "If you're able to find an elusive Soarer, you can tame them with Raw Fish and equip them with a Saddle to glide through the Martian skies with ease.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "They can't fly forever though, indicated by the wing icons on the top left, and will need to land occasionally. (You can feed them more Raw Fish to speed up their recovery.)",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Still, they're a great option for long-distance travel, and won't upset the sandworm either!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Note: Soarers are unable to survive on particularly hot planets such as Venus.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Need a lift?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Find a Soarer",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "Sniffers and Wraptors can be found all over Mars and can be domesticated for meat, eggs, and most importantly, their mineral-rich tufts and feathers.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mars",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mars.snbt",
          "text": "They eat any Martian crops, and you can automatically breed and feed them with the Feeding Troughs just like on Earth.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "In the EV Chapter, your main objective will be to craft your very first IV and LuV Circuits.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Along the way, several key challenges await you:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "• Build your first Alloy Blast Smelter, a faster version of the EBF, specialized for alloys. With it, you’ll be able to construct your first Large Machine: the Large Centrifuge, essential for the Nuclear Fission Line. It also lets you upgrade ore processing with a faster Thermal Centrifuge.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "• Master our original Tungsten Line - looping all the required materials will test both your knowledge and your patience.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "• Prepare to fly to Mars where you’ll become an extraterrestrial farmer while also learning to harness the power of the atom.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Good luck, this is where GregTech begins to show its true depth!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Let's go Nuclear on Mars",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This is Extreme Voltage",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This new rocket shouldn’t be too difficult to assemble, but you’ll notice a clear jump in material costs compared to your previous model.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The upgraded Rocket Alloys now require both Distilled Water and Cryogenized Fluix for cooling.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Make sure you've fully set up your Titanium production line, as you're going to need a lot of it going forward! A continuous production line will save you a lot of frustration down the road.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This one's purple",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(ad_astra:tier_2_rocket)item(tfg:tier_2_double_rocket))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Either rocket",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Rocket 2: Titanium Boogaloo",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Before landing on Mars, there are a few important things to keep in mind.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "First, like the Moon, Mars will have some hostile surface mobs as well. If you haven't already figured out how to make your Space Suit stay with you after dying or invested in new EV-tier weaponry, you'll have a rough time.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The planet is mostly a desert world, dotted with \"islands\" where you’ll find water, lush fauna, and much safer places to build your first base. Meanwhile, the open desert is extremely dangerous if you don't watch your step, but contains some other crucial resources!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "All fluid veins are spread across Mars, except for Heavy Ammoniacial Water which can only be found outside of the desert. That’s another good reason to set up your base there.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Energy-wise, Mars will not be kind to you at first.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Nearly every common energy generation method is disabled or worthless on the planet, which means you’ll have to rely almost entirely on Fission to power your base.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "At the very beginning, we recommend bringing along some filled batteries such as Lapotron Crystals to get started, and then look towards setting up Thorium Fuel Rods.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Achieving energy stability on Mars will take time and effort, but once your systems are running smoothly, you’ll feel like unlimited power is right in the palm of your hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "And one last tip: don’t kill everything you see. Some animals can be ranched, and you’ll definitely need them later in your progression.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Be sure to check out the Space Survival chapter for more Mars-related tips too!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Stay alert, plan ahead, and Mars will reward your courage.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Red Planet",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Land on Mars",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "I'm on Mars!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Congrats on making your first Tungsten! We hope you enjoy this small increase in complexity. Remember that, at first, the small amount of Tungsten you require can be achieved by simply inputting the Soda Ash you mined. This may inspire you to fully loop the process so you can automate it peacefully.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Also remember that the further you progress, the more important it will be to build dedicated and passive lines for all these complex processes that will be required until the end of the pack. Don’t be afraid of lacking resources, be afraid of lacking time.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Fully self-sustaining, just like Titanium",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Tungsten Line in TerraFirmaGreg has been completely reworked and you’ll be happy (or not) to know that it’s now much harder.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "It’s possible to fully loop every material in the Tungsten Line, but doing so requires a lot of engineering. Alternatively, you can brute-force your way through by mass-producing the resources you need.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "A little tip: Mars has several good ore veins for Soda Ash and Tungsten.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Take your time, optimize, and the Tungsten Line will become the foundation of your mid-to-late game progress.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Why? Just why?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The new Tungsten Line",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "all_started",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You know what to do with this by now, but this is a good time to give you a heads up that now is the time to scale up your factory if you haven't already done so.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Take your time to set up AE2 all over your base, making it print you dozens of new machines to keep your factory running at tip-top shape, because if you don't, the rest of EV is going to hit you like a brick wall.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Don't wait to find out the hard way!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "At the very least, here's what we recommend before pushing further into EV:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Passive production of Rubber, Polyethylene, Oxygen, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, and Chlorine",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- At least two general-purpose EBFs, and a few LCRs",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- AE2 patterns for a circuit of every tier and most of the common crafting components like motors, pumps, plates, and wires",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- A dedicated ore processing setup",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- A couple EV amps worth of power generation (see the below quests)",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You can do it, you've made it this far already!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Last step before some Extreme power generation!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "EV Assembler",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Distillation Tower (DT) is a direct multiblock upgrade of the Distillery. You won't have to choose outputs any more as the DT will handle them all automatically, at an increased power cost.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This machine will be your future bread and butter for anything involving Petrochem or Organic distillation.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ev__extreme_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ev__extreme_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Like the Cleanroom, the DT can be made taller, though not wider. Starting from the second layer, each added level requires an Output Hatch and grants one additional fluid output slot; if a level lacks its output hatch, the corresponding fluid will be voided. Count the number of outputs with EMI so you know how many layers you need. As always, use the Multiblock Preview tab in EMI and click the multiblock to see where you can place each part.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",

          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "T4 Anvil: Steel",

          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "With the Wrought Iron Anvil you'll be able to work Wrought Iron Ingots into different items such as Sheets, Tool heads, etc.",

          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",

          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "To work metal into more than just double ingots, you'll need to use an anvil of the same tier or better. Working on an anvil can be a little bit complicated, but there's an entry in the TFG Tips section of the field guide that goes into more detail.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Bronze also marks the start of automation, where you'll begin to harness mechanical power!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },

        },

        {

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",

        {

        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",

          "text": "Welding Bronze",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Bloomery is a Multiblock from TerraFirmaCraft that allows you to create Wrought Iron. Melting iron in a forge will produce Cast Iron, which is brittle and nowhere near as strong or durable as Wrought Iron.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Bloomery is expensive, so it will be worth investing some time into setting up automatic plate production and ore processing.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Field Guide contains a detailed entry on how the Bloomery works and the correct ratios of iron and fuel that it needs.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:mechanics/bloomery",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Required if you seek the Iron Age.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Blast Furnace is a multiblock structure that allows you to create Pig Iron. Placing a combination of Iron, Flux and fuel (see the adjacent quest) inside the Blast Furnace produces Pig Iron, which can be worked into Steel.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "In order for the Blast Furnace to reach its required high temperatures, it will need its own Bellows, used to force air through a Tuyere which you place inside the blast furnace.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Field Guide contains an entry on how the Blast Furnace works and how to build one.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Then I started Blastin'",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Blast Furnace",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Bellows is a device that can force extra air into a fire or forge in front of it, allowing the heat produced by the fuel inside to reach higher temperatures than usual, at the cost of fuel duration.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "These higher temperatures are required to fire pottery with charcoal or melt certain metals.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Coal and Coke can also reach higher temperatures without it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

        },
        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Higher temperatures can be reached, at a small price.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Once you find Kaolin Clay, you should bring as much back as you can possibly carry! Unfortunately, only 20 percent of it will successfully cook into Kaolinite Powder, so it's recommended to bake it in situ with pit kilns, to save inventory space.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "After you craft the Crucible and the Blast Furnace, you won't need much more of it, but it's still a good idea to bring home more than you think you'll need, to avoid a repeat journey.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "P.S.: If you've found blood lilies but no clay, try digging down a little further! Sometimes it spawns a little underground.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Kaolin Trek: The Next Generation",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Kaolin Clay",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "one_started",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Graphite spawns exclusively in flat, wide discs deep underground.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "You will have to go exploring underground through the caves to try and spot some! Graphite veins can spawn in any stone type and also include Coal and Diamond. However, due to the depth of the veins, indicators likely will not appear on the surface. Tools such as a metal Shield, Digger Helmet, Propick, and Spyglass can also prove to be very useful!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "You mean I can't just rely on surface indicators?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "We know that GregTech isn’t the easiest mod to get into — especially when it comes to the energy system. That’s why we’ll take our time in this chapter to explain as much as we can.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Some things here might not make full sense until later in your progression, so don’t stress yourself. Just try to understand what you can for now, and feel free to come back to this chapter whenever you have questions.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "We’ve split this chapter into four categories, each one covering a topic related to the GregTech Energy System. We’ll provide as many examples as possible to help you understand how it all works.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "It's not as bad as you think",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Welcome aboard",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Let's do some explaining",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Moving Energy in GregTech means understanding a few core mechanics.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "First, Energy Tiers. From LV to UHV, everything in GregTech — wires, machines, recipes — is tied to a tier. You’ll need the correct cable material to move energy. For example:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "• Tin wire = LV",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "• Copper wire = MV",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Second, you’ve got the Amperage mechanic. Think of 1 Amp (or 1A) as a packet of energy. Machines request energy \"packets\", which then get sent down the wire.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "• 1A of LV = 32 EU",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "• 1A of HV = 512 EU",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Most machines and energy hatches will only request 2A at maximum.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Mastering these two ideas is key before going further into energy distribution.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "So, energy transfer, huh",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "I understand",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Moving your Energy",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Storing your energy is one of the most fundamental pillars of the power system in GregTech.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Why is that? Simply because even the strongest generators won't be enough to keep up when you start a big craft — especially in late game.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "To deal with this, GregTech provides multiple solutions to store astronomical amounts of EU. These storages act as a buffer between your energy production and the machines that drain it during complex operations.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Whether you’re preparing for a Fusion Reactor, an LCR, or any HV-IV scale crafting chain, you’ll need that extra backup of energy to keep everything stable.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Don’t underestimate the power of a good battery — it may just be the thing that saves your base from a blackout during critical moments.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Gotta put all that juice somewhere",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Storing Energy",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "It’s all about making energy, right? This part won’t be the most complicated one, since producing energy in TerraFirmaGreg works pretty much like in standard GregTech.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "You’ll learn about the various methods to generate energy, as well as some of the fuels you can use to get the most out of your setup.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Gas or Oil?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Let's go!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Producing Energy",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "How to spend all this energy?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Use your machines! Sounds simple, right?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Well... not exactly. There are many small details that you should learn to help you on your quest to completing TerraFirmaGreg.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Basic Machines:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "- These machines are simple.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "- They can request up to 2A each.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "- If you input a higher tier of energy... 💥 they explode.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "GregTech Multiblocks:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Now things get interesting. Multiblocks offer more flexibility and power — if you understand how they work.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Standard Mechanics:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "- If a multiblock can accept two Energy Hatches (most of them), this allows you to use higher-tier recipes than the machine’s base tier.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "If you're building an Electric Blast Furnace and you install two LV Energy Hatches, it will be able to process MV-tier EBF recipes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "This is one of the key benefits of multiblocks over single-block machines — to upgrade them to the next tier, you only have to swap out their energy hatches instead of replacing the whole machine.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Some multiblocks only accept one Energy Hatch, but that doesn't mean you're limited to 1 amp!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "You can still use a 4A or 16A Energy Hatch. This will allow Overclocking of recipes, but not the recipe tier.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "The Large Circuit Assembler only allows one Energy Hatch. If you install a 4A IV Energy Hatch, you will be able to overclock all IV and lower recipes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "However, it cannot craft LuV-tier recipes because the machine doesn't support multiple hatches. That limitation is intentional, to prevent skipping the GregTech progression system.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "So remember: More amps on a single hatch means faster processing, but two hatches are required to unlock higher-tier recipes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Oh you will spend energy",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Spending Energy",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Moving energy around in GregTech can be tricky — most cables are lossy. For every block, for every amp, you might lose energy as it travels through your wires. But don’t worry, there are solutions:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "• Cover your wires with rubber. By doing so, you'll significantly reduce energy loss over distance. Just check the quest items for a reference.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "• Use higher-tier cables. Platinum cables, for example, only lose 1 EU per block — practically nothing when compared to the 8192 EU it can carry.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "• Superconductors. These beauties are a bit pricier, but they have zero loss. They don’t need rubber covers, and won't zap you either. Just be aware that they're usually only craftable near the end of their tier.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Optimize your energy flow — reduce losses and make your systems more efficient.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Funky to place",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "I finished looking at wires",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "Moving with wires",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "You’ll notice each wire has its own Max Amperage — that’s the amount of amps a cable can safely carry before burning.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "To know how many amps will flow through a cable, you must consider two things:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/gregtech_energy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/gregtech_energy.snbt",
          "text": "- A Generator or Battery outputs a specific amount of Amps:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "gregtech_energy",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The HV Chemical Bath is used to dye Lenses using Chemical Dye. This will let you engrave more types of Wafers, and cool other kinds of Hot Ingots.",

          "label": "hv__high_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/hv__high_voltage.snbt",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
