      "semantic_evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Pyrolyse Oven is an electric equivalent to the Coke Oven. It can produce Coal Coke and Charcoal with a Creosote byproduct just as before, but also has additional Organic Byproducts, the most beneficial of these being Wood Tar.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Another product is Biomass, which is more pertinent for your progression as of this moment.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The byproducts can be Distilled for an array of organic resources, with different byproducts giving different ratios of different chemicals.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You will need to take a peek at the Distillation Quest to get to grips with the power of distillation...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "There are recipes that can accept Nitrogen to double the speed. This isn't quite worth pursuing right now, but Nitrogen will eventually be free and infinite.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You should be more than fine with a single LV Energy Hatch, and Superconductors to supply a steady 64 EU/t. Additionally, Cupronickel Coils are perfect when you're getting used to the Pyrolyse Oven, but you may want to upgrade to Kanthal eventually.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: The Plant path is one path you can take towards Ethylene, which is a necessary chemical in progressing to HV. The other path involves Oil.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Pyrolyse Oven remains optional. However, it is very rewarding to construct one either for Power, or for the various Byproducts, and we highly recommend you give it a look.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: In GT5u, the structure for the Pyrolyse Oven was infamously a giant box with only 9 coils inside. Players usually spent several minutes debugging what is wrong due to a lack of a EMI preview.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Thermal Decomposition",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Pyrolyse Oven",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Welcome to the organic Ethylene path! The goal here is to produce Ethanol and mix it with Sulfuric Acid to make Ethylene.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "To get Ethanol, you'll need to distill it from Biomass—so let's look at the different ways to produce that biomass.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The first method is simple: put saplings into a Brewery with water. The downside? It's slow.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The second method is more complex, but yields much better results. You’ll need to get Bio Chaff, which comes from macerating Plant Balls. Note that you won't get any extra chance until you unlock HV Crushing.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Plant Balls can be obtained by:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "-Centrifuging Sugarcane or Beets",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "-Centrifuging every wood that you can tap #afc:tappable_logs",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "-Compressing saplings directly",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Finally, process your Bio Chaff with water in a Brewery or go for a Pyrolyse Oven for a 66 percent boost in output.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: You may recognise Plantballs from IndustrialCraft2! In IC2 Experimental, there was this rather... obscure way to turn Biomass into Biogas for power, which sadly required too much investment to be really worth it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Plants aren't industrial enough!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Brewery can be used to make Lubricant from Redstone and Creosote/Oil. Lubricant has some niche uses, namely being used in the Cutter to significantly reduce the duration of its recipes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Brewery is a very, very slow machine, but it requires almost no power to run its recipes. Building many Breweries will help you obtain enough Biomass on your quest for plastic.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: The Brewery unlocks the Biomass path towards Ethylene. The same can be done in the Pyrolyse Oven. The other path involves Oil.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: You could make your own Brewery if you want to build up a company and start selling Booze... in GregTech 6.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "*hic*... *hic*",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:lv_brewery)item(gtceu:mv_brewery))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Local Brewery selling Booze",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Our warmest congratulations on making it here.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The way you should obtain Ethylene was described in the previous Quest, depending on the route you chose.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Ethylene will shortly be used in polymer production. It's also useful in a few other reactions.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "One of many hydrocarbons",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Click here to complete this quest/task",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Put your previously made Biomass into a MV Distillery to make Ethanol.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You will need this for Ethylene by reacting it with Sulfuric Acid in a MV Chemical Reactor... unless you chose to go down the Oil path.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Once you have a hefty starting stock of Ethanol, consider making and distilling Fermented Biomass in a Distillation Tower (when you get there!) for extra chemicals.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Do not try to use Ethanol as a Power source... it's quite possibly its worst use. If it's organic Power that you want, we suggest taking a look at Benzene instead!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Yo, wait - that's alcohol!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Distillating Oil or Raw Oil will give you Fuel that you will need to desulfurize.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Hydrogen Sulfide is perfectly recycled in an Electrolyzer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "To automate this process, simply place your Chemical Reactor and your Electrolyzer next to each other. Be sure to use your Screwdriver to enable input from the output side.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Naphtha is a good Product source, surprsingly it's also a really good fuel (we heard nerf is coming) but if you are sitting on Oil sand or you don't have Raw Oil then Light Oil may be better. Keep following the quests to the right for more details.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "We're still confused on how Naphtha is pronounced",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Naphtha or Light Oil Residue",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Don't panic! We'll mostly be doing this to get hydrocarbons.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "There are many ways to acquire Ethylene from Oil processing. It's easy to get lost in all the options and recipes!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The best way is to steam-crack Naphtha in a Chemical Reactor. Be sure to make the Severely Steam-Cracked version for a higher yield of Ethylene.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Once in HV, you'll have the option to do this recipe in the Cracking Unit at 100 percent efficiency. Unfortunately, the recipes you are doing with the Chemical Reactor have a loss of 50 percent.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: All of this looks and feels terribly inefficient - we hope that's strong motivation to tier up! The Distillation Tower will be a huge upgrade for petrochem, but you're not quite there... yet. Right now, you'll have to use a Distillery to get Ethylene.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Fuel and oil cracking can get complicated...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Fuel Cracking",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Hello there, and welcome to MV Energy Production.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "In this quest, we’ll go over the different options available to keep your MV machines powered and running smoothly.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "We won’t cover this in every chapter, so we highly recommend that you read the dedicated chapter on GregTech Energy for a deeper understanding of how everything works.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "For now, here are your three main options:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Use an MV Generator to directly produce MV-level energy.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Step up your LV power by using transformers, with a 4:1 ratio between LV and MV.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Convert RF using your Alternator to get MV energy directly.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Higher-tier Generators will increase their fuel consumption proportionally to their Generation rate, keeping the duration of fuels and the specific amount of energy from fuels the same. The Advanced Steam Turbine will use 5,120 mB Steam per second, equivalent to 256 mB/t.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/mv__medium_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Get any of the generators to complete this quest, but you may prefer starting off with the Advanced Steam Turbine.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "mv__medium_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],

        }

      "semantic_evidence": [
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "ore_processing",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "An important part of GregTech is its Ore Processing Mechanics, but it can get pretty complicated, so this chapter is here to help!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "To start with, you should be aware of the Ore Processing Diagram tab in EMI - Press the Show Uses key (default U) on any item related to ore processing and look for the tab with the vanilla Iron Ore icon. This diagram may look overwhelming at first, but we'll take it step by step.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "A major part of GregTech philosophy is that there's not just one way to solve a problem, but we've marked everything important with a star, so if you're completely lost, try following those!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "To Process, Ore Not To Process",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "I agree to not just dump everything in a furnace",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Welcome to Ore Processing",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "While looking at EMI, you've probably noticed that your Macerator or Millstone lists more outputs than what you're actually getting.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "GregTech doesn't communicate this very well, but these extra slots are only available in HV. Once you make it to that tier, the HV macerator becomes incredibly powerful, giving a huge amount of bonus byproducts from each ore.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "I can get even more from my ores!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:hv_macerator)item(greate:stainless_steel_crushing_wheel))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Either an HV Macerator or HS Crushing Wheels",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Crushing with byproducts",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "text": "The Millstone is an automatic version of the Quern. You can throw whatever you'd like into the top, and then right-click to take your crushed items back out. It's pretty slow if you connect it directly to your Animal Crank, but you can use gear ratios to increase its speed.",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "You will only receive the output in the first slot. The other slots are part of a GregTech mechanic that won't be relevant until much later (HV).",

          "label": "questssteam_age",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "The Animal Crank is your first accessible source of mechanical power. To use it, place the crank on the center of a 7x7 cleared area and leash an animal to it. Different animals will provide different amounts of power, while the blocks underneath will increase the speed of the output power. The area of multiple cranks can overlap.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "You may need to hold a second lead to attach an animal.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Small Animals (16 SU):",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Wolf, Dog, Pig, Sheep, Goat, Alpaca",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Medium Animals (24 SU):",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Cow, Donkey",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Large Animals (32 SU):",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Horse, Mule, Musk Ox, Yak",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Make your livestock pay rent",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Your First Power Source",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Does crafting all those plates for a Bloomery look tedious? The Helve Hammer will automatically (but slowly) flatten double ingots into plates for you. You'll still have to do the welding yourself though. Simply place an anvil directly under the hammer and throw your double ingots onto it by pressing the Throw Item key (Default: Q), then right-click the hammer to get your plates out.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Higher tier anvils will also require fewer hits to make plates from the previous tier.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Be sure to use cogs to increase its speed!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "It may be unimpressive to start, but once you're able to increase its speed to 256 RPM with Steel cogs and shafts, the Helve Hammer will really start to shine.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "CLANG... CLANG... CLANG...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Helve Hammer",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Greate is a fusion of Create and GregTech that has different tiered versions of Create's machines. It also introduces stress limits on Shafts and Cogwheels, so you'll have to plan more about how you power your machinery!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Generally speaking, you'll want smaller setups with their own individual power sources, instead of doing the usual Create thing of having a blob of water wheels connected into a single Shaft into your base.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Tired of Create? This'll make it more interesting",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Basics of Greate",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Water wheels provide much more power than the Animal Crank, at the expense of requiring flowing water. You don't have the ability to move water sources yet, so you'll need to find a river to power these. Oceans and Lakes can also provide a little power, but if you're far inland, you're better off looking at building a windmill.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "You can get treated wood by soaking any planks in creosote from your Coke Oven.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Hope you set up your base near a river!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Water Wheels",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "If you aren't near flowing water, a windmill is another effective option for a better source of power. Bigger windmills provide more stress units and faster speeds.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Pairs well with tulips",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "These are the basis of most of the simple machines you can build with Create. Check JEI for all the different things you can craft with this, including Gearboxes and other ways to control your stress units.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "New to Create? There's many tutorials online about different kinds of contraptions you can build, and most of them will still work in TFG too! (Except anything involving cobble generators)",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Primitive Machine Hull?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Metal Casings",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "The Encased Fan is the final step in your first fully automatic ore processing line, so you no longer need to clean your impure dusts by hand.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Greate's Encased Fans work a little differently than in base Create. Instead of placing a water source in front of the fan, you'll need to pump water into the encased fan block itself. Be sure to set the number on the fan to 1!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Next, place your crushed ore or dusts on a Depot or Belt in front of the fan (the floor will NOT work!), and they'll be gleaming in no time. As a bonus, it'll give you some extra byproducts too!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Great for hot days",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Encased Fan",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "With the Steel Age, now you can automate fluids as well as items! The Mechanical Pump can pull fluids out of pretty much anything, including barrels, crucibles, and even source blocks. You can use it with either Create's or GregTech's fluid pipes, though each behaves a little differently.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Create's pipes have no internal fluid capacity, instead transporting fluids directly from source to destination. You can right-click them with a Copper Casing to \"lock\" any connections in place, and right-clicking them with a wrench will open a little window that prevents intersections, so you can run multiple pipes next to each other. Create's pipes also require a mechanical pump to use, and each pump only has a range of 16 blocks, but one pump can pull fluids from multiple sources at once.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "They also have no temperature limit!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "On the other hand, GregTech's pipes do have their own internal fluid capacity and don't require a pump once fluid is inside them. Like item pipes, their connections can also be fully controlled by sneak right-clicking them with an empty off-hand, and we recommend doing so on all your pipes otherwise the fluid sloshes around.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Are your mechanical pumps and GregTech pipes not connecting? Flip the pump twice (right-click with a wrench) and that should get them working together.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Delicious pipe spaghetti",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Fluid Handling",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Steam machines need to be powered! You have three options to generate steam: the Solid boiler accepts solid fuels like coal and charcoal, the Liquid boiler accepts liquids like creosote and lava, and the Solar boiler requires no fuel but only works during the day. The choice is yours, but we recommend the liquid one if you're unsure.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Steam machines all have a vent which needs to stay unblocked in order for them to work properly.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Warning: Boilers will explode if you attempt to put water into them while they are dry and hot. It's best to always have water being pumped into them, but you can always break and place the block to reset its temperature.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Portable Steamroom",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:hp_steam_solid_boiler)item(gtceu:hp_steam_liquid_boiler)item(gtceu:hp_steam_solar_boiler))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Any High Pressure Steam Boiler",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Steam Boilers",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Water wheels and windmills not cutting it any more? It wouldn't be a steam age without a proper steam engine! Each steam engine can output a whole 256 SU, giving you much more power to play with.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Blaze Burners can be crafted without leaving your house, and you can use a Mechanical Arm to automatically feed them solid fuel, or directly pipe liquid fuel (such as creosote). Coal Gems, Anthracite, and Coke can also be used to superheat them.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Time for some real steam power",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Steam Engine",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",
          "text": "Tired of chopping trees? These will do it for you! Place them on a spinning contraption and watch them go. Unfortunately, you'll still have to replant the saplings them yourself until you get access to a Deployer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "questssteam_age",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questssteam_age",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questssteam_age.snbt",

          "label": "queststfc_tips",

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Firmalife is a mod all about extending the agricultural and gastronomic experience in TerraFirmaCraft, with touches of miscellaneous features. Includes things such as decorations, more preservation methods, new foods, bees and a plethora of useful gadgets!",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",

          "text": "Utilizing the Vacuum Chamber and some additional heating, you can process Latex from various trees into Raw Rubber Pulp through a specific process.           "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The Zero Point Module (item) is a non-rechargable battery with TONS of energy stored. You may have found one of these before now, but you haven't been able to discharge it until reaching ZPM.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",

        },
        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "These can only be found as loot from Jungle Temples. They're exceptionally rare - don't worry about finding one.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "item_ref_count": 32

        {

          "item_ref_count": 32

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",

        },
        {

        },
        {

        },
        {

        },
        {

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Enriched Naquadah is an isotope of Naquadah, Nq-528. It is radioactive and will be used in (as of yet) unimplemented nuclear reactors.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Currently, you just need it to make Trinium Coils.",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",

        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",

          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",

        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "These coils are required for progressing to the second half of ZPM, and beyond.",

          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "IT'S OVER 9000!!!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Trinium Coils",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The Research Station is the upgrade to the Scanner. It's used for more advanced forms of research, and will finally allow you to perform research which requires Data Orbs and Modules.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "When running the Research Station, energy and Computation is needed. The latter is provided through an HPCA, which is explained in the next quest. It is recieved with a Computation Data Reception Hatch. Note that only one Reception Hatch is allowed in a Research Station.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "This multiblock needs computation sporadically, which means the recipe will not reverse progress if you don't supply enough - it will simply halt in-place. However, the machine will still draw energy constantly, even when recieving no computation.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "To scan items, the process is relatively similar. In the Object Holder, place the target item in the center slot, and the data storage item in the other slot. Then provide computation, and the data storage item will be updated upon completion. When running, the target item will be Locked and cannot be removed.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Note: To form this multiblock, the Object Holder must face the controller.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Your research adventures continue!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Research Station",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The UV Mainframe is required to move into Fusion Mk2.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "It's also made in the Assembly Line.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Passing over the ingredients we've already seen before, watch out for the HSS-E Frames.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "...ah, here we go!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "First UV Circuits!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The Crystal SoC is used to make cheaper Crystal Circuits. Enjoy the discount!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Crystal SoCs require ZPM Emitters, which means you need a Data Orb for their research.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "In the future, these may become more difficult to make.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: In GT5u, the texture for this item was red, and did not have the special design on it. There was a \"raw\" version with the design, but it was used for other unrelated things. Who knows why?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "When engraving it once isn't enough",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Crystal SoC",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "This hatch allows you to store more Data Storage Items than the basic one.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Don't forget that this hatch requires a Data Orb for research.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Increased storage density!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Advanced Data Access Hatch",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadria is an isotope of Naquadah, Nq-522. It's highly unstable, but it'll still be used for UV components, Fusion Mk2, and when fusing Neutronium.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Naquadah, but radioactive-er!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Production of Sterilized Growth Medium is the final processing line in GTCEu, for now.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "You will need this for your first Wetware Circuits.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Producing it won't be as much of a hassle as PBI, but nearly every step requires a Sterilized Cleanroom. This means you'll have to get creative with how you use your space.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Make sure to scrutinise every step of the chain. Some recipes are much more efficient than others!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Pro Tip: You can wall-share cleanrooms with doors in-between too if you want more space.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: GTCEu's Sterilized Growth Medium chain is loosely based off of Bartworks' from GTNH. The main difference is that GTNH required a Bacterial Vat multiblock, which was more complex than the ordered Assembly Line. GTCEu is considering adding a multiblock like it but with their own spin in the future.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "More Lore: In Gregicality Legacy, the Sterilized Growth Medium production chain was very different. It was one of the most difficult processes in the mod, with over 30 complicated steps! It was based off of producing different real-life vitamins and nutrients.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Even More Lore: In Shadows of Greg, this was made with just Distilled Water and Mince Meat. How far we've come...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The final processing line, at last!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Sterilized Growth Medium",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "The ZPM Lapotronic Orb is even better than the LuV one! It of course comes at a price...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: Imagine making 64 IV or 8 LuV Orbs for just one of these! See the Lore for the LuV orb for details.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "A power singularity!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Mega Batteries",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "This Quest will be completed with either a ZPM Energy Hatch... or a ZPM Dynamo Hatch for your Multiblock Generators.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/zpm__zero_point_module.snbt",
          "text": "Don't forget that 16 Amp variants exist!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "zpm__zero_point_module",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        }
      ],
